CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	event_metadata JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	age INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	city VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	pre_approved_limit_paise INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	declared_salary_paise INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	credit_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	score_source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	limit_source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	phone_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	address_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_keys (
	key VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	endpoint VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	response_body JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS support_messages (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32), 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	contact VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	topic VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS applications (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	requested_amount_paise INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tenure_months INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS verified_identities (
	identity_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	issuer VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	consent_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (identity_hash), 
	UNIQUE (customer_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS decisions (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	application_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	reason_codes JSON NOT NULL, 
	emi_paise INTEGER, 
	policy_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	interest_rate_percent INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tenure_months INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	inputs_snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	application_id VARCHAR(32), 
	doc_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	original_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	extracted_fields JSON, 
	extraction_confidence FLOAT, 
	verified_income_paise INTEGER, 
	requires_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_document_app_type UNIQUE (application_id, doc_type), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pilot_quotes (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	terms JSON NOT NULL, 
	expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	application_id VARCHAR(32), 
	accepted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id), 
	UNIQUE (application_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_reviews (
	document_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	application_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reviewer VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	income_paise INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (document_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extraction_jobs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_audit_events_action ON audit_events (action)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_audit_events_created_at ON audit_events (created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_audit_events_entity_id ON audit_events (entity_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_customers_phone ON customers (phone)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_idempotency_keys_customer_id ON idempotency_keys (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_support_messages_created_at ON support_messages (created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_support_messages_customer_id ON support_messages (customer_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_support_messages_reference ON support_messages (reference)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_support_messages_status ON support_messages (status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_applications_customer_created ON applications (customer_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_applications_customer_id ON applications (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_applications_status ON applications (status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_decisions_application_id ON decisions (application_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_documents_application_id ON documents (application_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_documents_customer_id ON documents (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_documents_status ON documents (status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_pilot_quotes_customer_id ON pilot_quotes (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_document_reviews_application_id ON document_reviews (application_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_extraction_jobs_document_id ON extraction_jobs (document_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_extraction_jobs_status ON extraction_jobs (status)
